trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Play the whole game and earn the other 54 trophies first. The Platinum pops automatically once the last one unlocks, so use the roadmap below and clear missables on your first run.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it. It is the first mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story progress only, no side requirement.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story progress only.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story progress only.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story progress only.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Pick the ending you want first, then replay the mission from the replay menu if you need the other choices for trophies 48-49.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. If you fail or skip a story beat inside it, replay the mission from the mission replay menu before moving on.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Finish its objectives in one run, then replay it if an objective was missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Replay it from the mission menu if you need a cleaner run.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Replay it if an in-mission objective is missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Replay it if needed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Replay it if an objective is missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, collectible set, activity and challenge in the checklist. Use the in-game stats page to find what is left, then mop up region by region.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Do stunts around Leonida until the counter reaches 250. Jumps, near-misses and air time all count. A fast bike on the highway and the airport ramps are the easiest places to repeat them.
trophies.source: Rockstar Games — GTA VI activities; PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of every activity type once: races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation spots and the rest. The checklist shows which types you have tried.
trophies.source: Rockstar Games — GTA VI activities; PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each range layout, use a steady weapon, and retry a challenge until the gold time/score is beaten.
trophies.source: Rockstar Games — GTA VI activities; PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone race location. Learn each course once in practice, then race it for the win.
trophies.source: Rockstar Games — GTA VI activities; PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter a new race each time and keep a note of which ones you have won; repeat wins in the same race do not add to the count.
trophies.source: Rockstar Games — GTA VI activities; PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish where the challenge marker is, match the bait to the fish, and keep tension steady so the line does not snap.
trophies.source: Rockstar Games — GTA VI activities; PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game in an arcade. Any game counts, so pick the shortest one.
trophies.source: Rockstar Games — GTA VI activities; PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Do his missions when they appear and do not leave the strand unfinished before the story moves on.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Talk to every stranger marker you pass and finish each strand; the map shows strands you have started.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. Check the map for the spots, visit each one, and use the meditate prompt there.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until he marks the animal, then track it in the marked area and take it down cleanly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found around Leonida; trade duplicates and check the set list to see which cards each set still needs.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Open the WAiNK It prompt at a new spot each time; the counter only rises for locations you have not used before.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the challenge list in the pause menu and clear the easy ones first; stunt, race and combat challenges stack with other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it together and escape. Get the wanted level away from a safehouse, then break line of sight and hide until it clears. Do it in one attempt.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route with 3 shops close together, rob each quickly, and keep moving between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive a vehicle you have not driven before and it counts; try new districts, car parks and traffic types to find the last few.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies in a single use. Wait until a group is close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: get into a plane at the airport and take off without following the normal departure. Do it before the airport area is locked down in later story.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it. Find a Rhino at a military area, drive it into traffic, and keep the heat on until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, take the goods and leave before the alarm. If spotted, restart the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway vehicle first, crack the vault, then lose the wanted level before the next one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash, and lose the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: visit every district and named area on the map. Drive the highways and back roads until the map's fog is gone.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find one operation per gang on the map, hit it, and escape; the checklist tracks which gangs are done.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. Any beachfront bar on Ocean Beach counts.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and keep going; do it during the story beat that opens the showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and finish a game. Follow through on the lanes as the description says.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal: play partner missions and activities together until the partnership rating rises. The rating is shown in the partner menu.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice in the final mission (for better or worse). This is a choice trophy: pick one ending, then replay the final mission to see the other choice for trophy 49.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Make the other story choice in the final mission. Replay the final mission from the mission replay menu and pick the second option.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger the secret event the description hints at. Explore the odd locations in Leonida after the story, and follow the in-world clues; the trophy pops when the event plays out.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list, 2026-11-18 — flagged Unverified: exact trigger is not in the official description

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl over 10 pins with a melee drive-by: drive past the bowling alley pins and hit them with a melee weapon from the moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills from heists, then launder them in batches through a contact; the counter tracks the total laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, vehicles and upgrades; the total is cumulative across every shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Save up, then buy each garage from the property menu when it is listed.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle you own, and repeat for 10 different vehicles.
